key_insight: WorldLatent proposes a unified 4D latent space for perceiving and generating dynamic worlds. Its central idea is to bring GPT-style unification to visual information spanning three spatial dimensions and time.
problem_solved: The paper targets the lack of a shared representation that can connect understanding and generation tasks in 4D spatiotemporal vision.
method: Represent dynamic worlds in a unified 4D latent space, as indicated by the title.
